rationale: The target is a faithful law-level formalization of the pinned source sentence. The finite Boolean product PMF is not merely suggestive of iid trials: its point mass is explicitly the product of p at every success coordinate and 1-p at every failure coordinate, so it encodes identical Bernoulli(p) marginals and independence. Mapping this law through the number of true coordinates is exactly taking the distribution of the Bernoulli sum. The right side is the standard binomial PMF on counts 0 through N, embedded into Nat. The explicit strict hypotheses 0 < p, p < 1, and 0 < N now match the source's p ∈ (0,1) and positive-integer N exactly.
